summary: **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** Non-Compliance of the provisions of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Standards of Performance of inter-State Transmission licensees) Regulations, 2012. **AND** The Commission has notified the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Standards of Performance of inter-State Transmission licensees) Regulations, 2012 (hereinafter referred to as “SOP Regulations”) on 17.09.2012. Regulation 8 of the SOP Regulations provides as under: ## “ **8. Information to be furnished by the inter-State Transmission Licensees:** - _(1)_ All inter State transmission licensees, in accordance with section 59 of the Act, shall furnish to the Commission, (a) the level of performance achieved, and (b) the number of cases in which compensation was paid, and (c) the aggregate amount of the compensation, in the formats in the Schedule of these regulations. - _(2) Such information in the requisite formats shall be submitted to the Commission twice during the financial year, on six monthly basis by 31_ _st_ _October and 30th_ # **_“(2) Such information in the requisite formats shall be submitted to the Commission on yearly basis by 30_** **_th_** **_April for the previous financial year_ .”** 5. Vide a circular number No. L-1/261/2025/CERC dated 08.05.2025, the inter-State Transmission Licensees were directed to submit the reasons for non-submission of data in compliance with the SOP Regulations for the period from 01.04.2022 onwards in the specified formats. The transmission licensees were also directed to submit the actual performance against the specified Standards of Performance and the aggregate amount of compensation paid, if any, and submit a copy of the webpage of their website highlighting the portion where such information has been displayed. It is pertinent to mention that the information pertaining to Regulation 8 was required to be submitted within 15 days of the aforesaid letter. However, such information was not filed by all the transmission licensees. From the data obtained from the NLDC website for the calculation of transmission charges under the 2020 Sharing Regulations for October 2025 and the CEA monthly monitoring report of the transmission system for 4. It is observed that almost all the inter-State Transmission Licensees have not reported specified data as per the SOP Regulations. We express our displeasure with the Transmission licensees for failing to comply with the aforesaid Regulatory provisions. 5. Accordingly, show cause notice is given to the Respondent transmission licensees (Respondents 1 to 129) as to why action under Section 142 of the Electricity Act, 2003 should not be initiated for non-compliance with the directions and contravention of the regulatory provision. The Respondents are directed to provide a copy of compliance reports which were required to be furnished for the period starting from the financial year 2021-2022 to the financial year 2024-2025, and when these were furnished to the Commission, and the reasons for non-submission of required reports. The reply to the show cause notice shall be filed within 15 days of the Order. # ** Transmission Service Providers that have not submitted any information in compliance of SoP Regulation, 2012: ** ED
